scope.test_actor: maintainer using the real remote CLI and normal Android system UI

build.confirmation: Version fields came from the phone executor in successful remote ping responses, including wait-ready embedded ping.

evidence: Root maintainer tool records: pre/post upgrade ready and ping invoked the complete canonical CLI path directly.
Subsequent status and HOME receipts were generated through private call.py; reviewer read that helper and confirmed it invokes the same canonical CLI path.
Reviewer independently hashed the current canonical CLI, checked VERSION, and matched the SHA to the downloaded invitation artifact.
cli_provenance.legacy_attempt_excluded: Old local pair.py, airtap.py and remote.py were retained from an earlier failed attempt and were not used by attempt2. Their CLI.7 pin does not describe this run.
cli_provenance.runtime_scope: Maintainer Python CLI, not Muse or another personal-AI runtime.

evidence_types.remote_receipts: Existing private CLI JSON files were read and reduced to allowlisted operational fields. Device URL, controller token, claim/code, connection ID and arbitrary content are excluded.
evidence_types.system_ui: Direct observations reported by the root maintainer operating the emulator. Not every UI observation has an independent saved screenshot attachment.
evidence_types.ui_driver: Root confirmed the UiAutomation driver uses FLAG_DONT_SUPPRESS_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES. The reviewer did not run it or touch the device.
evidence_types.timestamps: File modification timestamps indicate receipt capture, not exact UI-action time or continuous observation.

normal_ui_sequence: ADB placed the APK only; Files opened the APK
Play Protect More details then Install without scanning

failure_retained.interpretation: A separate ping after the successful ready result timed out. This run is not represented as uniformly successful or zero-failure connectivity.

notification_off.ui_action: Airtap notifications switched off through normal Android system notification UI
notification_off.ui_result: The same system notification page remained visible; HOME was not observed to execute.
notification_off.app_ui: Original AI connection retained; restore the missing permission without pairing again.
notification_off.interpretation: There was a stale online indicator, followed by a timed-out command and later offline state. Outcome unknown is not an explicit denial receipt. Source review shows synchronous notification gating before actions; the observable evidence supports no HOME effect in this test, not proof of all possible in-flight actions being instantly cancelled.

notification_restore.ui_action: Only the existing notification permission was switched back on
notification_restore.interpretation: The original pair resumed after notification restoration and a real remote HOME completed. This does not measure an exact restoration latency or establish long-duration unattended behavior.

remote_preparation_ui.battery_optimization_observed: still subject to system battery optimization
remote_preparation_ui.boundary_shown_in_ui: These are current settings checks, not proof that screen-off, network recovery, or unattended tasks have passed.

owner_stop.type: local owner stop, not whole relay revocation
direct_ui_observations: After notification off/on and opening Airtap again, it did not automatically resume the old control session
owner_stop.interpretation: Local trust was stopped and the old remote session remained unavailable after the tested owner actions. Approved relay metadata is expected for notification-only local stop; it is not evidence of unauthorized execution. The generic CLI503 receipts are retained as unknown outcomes, not mislabeled as confirmed server revocation.
owner_stop.background_timer_or_process_death_covera: not separately demonstrated by these native observations

not_claimed: Muse or any other personal-AI independent execution
Physical Android phone behavior or other OS/OEM versions
Fresh user installation from zero rather than upgrade
Instantaneous relay disconnection on notification disable
Explicit refusal evidence for commands whose actual receipt says outcome unknown
Every possible in-flight gesture or late callback race native-tested
Unattended operation merely because readiness settings were shown
Full server-side revocation from the notification-only stop action
Fresh controller or personal-AI bootstrap/pairing acceptance from the artifact-integrity check alone

new_invitation_artifact_integrity.sequence: Only after explicit local stop and owner selection to issue a new invitation; original pair had remained unchanged during upgrade and notification recovery.
new_invitation_artifact_integrity.method: Actual phone invitation from authenticated live v4 service; compare expectations from phone UI before reading guide or executing downloaded code
new_invitation_artifact_integrity.boundary: Proves actual phone invitation SHA expectations match downloaded guide and CLI on the live public service. It is not a new personal-AI first connection or a fresh-controller pairing acceptance.

old_controller_after_explicit_new_invita.action: Owner explicitly requested a new invitation after the local stop test
old_controller_after_explicit_new_invita.interpretation: The old controller was refused with HTTP401 after the explicit new-invitation action. This is separate from notification-only local stop, whose relay metadata had remained approved; it must not be used as evidence that the earlier notification stop itself performed relay revocation.

cleanup.new_invitation: No controller or approval was created. Test emulator was stopped; invitation expiry was not separately observed.
